title: And I'd Love it if We made it

additional: Spoilers for Book 6: The Long Game (Game Changers)

summary:
Would you choose me?
In hindsight, Shane realizes he might have been a bit stupid when he blurted that out.
I already chose you, Hollander.
Scratch that, he was plenty stupid. Ilya would probably think he wasted the past few years for a love not returned.
He wanted to tell Ilya in person, the next time they were supposed to meet. We will talk when we are in the same room again. It had sounded like a promise. It had been a promise.
It's still a promise. He tells himself. But he's not sure if that's something he could keep now. I don't think I've been good at keeping my promises, Ilya. I'm sorry.
Outside, the world continues to burn.
